verdict.rationale: IVS's own user guide refers to running a CLI command with a `--region` flag, which points to an official AWS CLI path for managing IVS resources. That is only a single passing mention, though, and it gives no detail on commands, coverage, or agent-friendly use. Missing for 10: documented IVS CLI command reference, installation and authentication guidance, scope of operations covered, AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. structured output or non-interactive use), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
